primary_policy: adaptive: mean corrected bootstrap dispersion divided by 1+query_cost exceeds mean restart dispersion divided by R
primary_outcome: final latent interpolation NMSE; log10(NMSE+1e-8) aggregated equally by equation and regime
baseline_selection: Choose the best fixed allocation rate separately by query cost from development tasks only, averaging log10(NMSE+1e-8) across all three development functions, both noise levels and all 12 seeds. Freeze before reading main results. Rates 0, .25, .5, .75, 1.
inference: Paired differences; equation-cluster percentile bootstrap 10000 resamples, retaining all matched seeds/noise/costs in each cluster. Descriptive regime heatmaps. No claim of benchmark-wide algorithm dominance.
sensitivity: Preplanned depth5/population64/generations3 budget128 on rational, interaction, oscillator, rational3d; all 20 main seeds; noise.1; costs.25,4; adaptive,search_only,sample_always,fixed_50,uncorrected. B,R sensitivity pairs (2,2),(3,5),(5,3) on same four functions with 10 seeds, cost1, noise.1.
engineering: Airfoil and concrete pool based retrospective label acquisition; random75/25 splits,384 pool rows,initial32;30 seeds;cost.25,1,4;budget96;population48,generations3;no added noise.
counterfactual_audit: Clone the same frozen pre-action state and run the unchosen and chosen actions. Compare a cost-matched integer horizon: five searches versus one label followed by four searches at lambda1. Evaluate on fresh held-out audit points. These targets never enter live policy or tuning. Record tie rate and actual risk reductions.
novelty_limits: Nested variance component subtraction is classical; the research target is its operational reliability as a two-resource decision signal in evolutionary symbolic regression. Persistent adaptive trajectories do not satisfy iid nested random-effects assumptions exactly.
hardware: Evaluate compiled CPU and Metal GPU tree prediction before backend selection; parallelize independent experiment runs.
